description: Roll out budget alerts and tagging enforcement across an AWS organization. Must: define tag policy (owner, environment, cost-center), apply tag policy via SCP, configure AWS Budgets per account and per team, set up SNS alerts for 50%/80%/100% threshold, create anomaly detection alerts, and verify alerts fire correctly. Risk factors: tag policy blocking legitimate resource creation, budget thresholds too noisy, anomaly detection false positives, SCP tag policy enforcement too strict. Tools available: aws CLI, AWS Budgets, SNS, SCP, terraform.
